items.headline: Lithium miners see storage demand surge
items.snippet: US-headquartered Albemarle Corp said global lithium demand grew 45% through May from a year earlier, outstripping supply growth. Inventories of the battery material held by industry players in China are declining, suggesting tightness in the market.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. Chinese lithium producers Tianqi Lithium and Ganfeng Lithium each posted their strongest first-half net income in three years. US-headquarter

items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle is well-placed to gain from long-term growth in the battery-grade lithium market. ALB expects lithium demand to witness a CAGR of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030, with stationary storage a significant driver.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: Albemarle Corp. (NYSE:ALB) stock traded lower Tuesday as JPMorgan reduced its earnings estimates and price forecast for the lithium producer. Analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas maintained a Neutral rating and lowered the December 2027 price forecast to $140 from a previous $160.

items.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Albemarle, Sociedad Quimica and Rio Tinto
items.snippet: Reflecting the retreat in lithium prices, ALB stock broke below its 50-day SMA on May 15, 2026, and below its 200-day SMA on June 23, 2026, signaling a bearish trend after a death crossover on July 21, 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) will likely benefit from factors like its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, as well as continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties, RBC Capital Markets said. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $1
